display_fil: Kaso: May diabetes si Joel at gumagamit ng niresetang gamot
display_en: Case: Joel has diabetes and takes prescribed medicine
narration_fil: May diabetes si Joel at gumagamit ng niresetang gamot. Nagtanong siya kung puwedeng ipalit ang ampalaya.
narration_en: Joel has diabetes and takes prescribed medicine. He asks whether Ampalaya can replace it.

narration_fil: Sa reference card, hanapin ang Momordica charantia. Ang nakalistang bahagi ay dahon; ang paksang gamit ay pagkontrol ng blood sugar sa payo ng clinician. Sabihin kung ano ang alam at hindi alam. Itanong ang kasalukuyang gamot at sintomas. Iugnay ang tanong sa clinician na sumusubaybay sa blood sugar at iba pang gamot ni Joel.
narration_en: Find Momordica charantia on the reference card. The listed part is leaves; the use topic is blood-sugar management under clinical advice. State what is known and unknown. Ask about current medicine and symptoms. Refer the question to the clinician monitoring Joel’s blood sugar and other medicines.

display_en:
What is the first response?
Choose before reading the explanation.

check.prompt_fil: Aling bahagi ng Ampalaya ang nakalista sa card?
check.prompt_en: Which Ampalaya part is listed on the card?

options.fil: Anumang bahagi ng halaman sa bakuran kahit hindi ito nakumpirmang Ampalaya.
options.en: Any part of a yard plant even when its identity as Ampalaya is unconfirmed.

options.fil: Hindi kailangang malaman ang botanical name.
options.en: The botanical name need not be checked.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Hindi ligtas ang hindi nakumpirmang bahagi at pagkakakilanlan. 2: Itugma ang bahagi sa nakasulat na source; hindi pa ito dose. 3: Magkapareho ang tawag sa ilang magkakaibang halaman.
check.feedback_en: 1: Unconfirmed part and identity are unsafe. 2: Match the part to the written source; this is not a dose. 3: Common names may cover different plants.

narration_fil: Piliin muna ang sagot. Pagkatapos, basahin ang paliwanag sa bawat pagpipilian.
narration_en: Choose an answer first. Then read the explanation for each option.

narration_fil: Itinuro ng BHW ang Ampalaya at botanical name sa card. Hindi niya pinaghulaang tama ang halamang nasa bakuran. Iugnay ang tanong sa clinician na sumusubaybay sa blood sugar at iba pang gamot ni Joel.
narration_en: The BHW points to Ampalaya and its botanical name on the card. The yard plant is not assumed to be identified. Refer the question to the clinician monitoring Joel’s blood sugar and other medicines.

display_en:
Do not prescribe a dose.
Do not replace medicine.
Consult a clinician.
narration_fil: Ang pagkain at halamang gamot ay hindi awtomatikong kapalit ng diabetes plan. Huwag ihinto o baguhin ang gamot. Hindi awtorisasyon ang lesson na ito para maghanda o mag-dose ng halamang gamot.
narration_en: Food or a plant is not an automatic substitute for a diabetes plan. Do not stop or change medication. This lesson does not authorize preparation or dosing of an herbal remedy.

display_fil:
Ano ang susunod na hakbang?
Subukan bago tingnan ang paliwanag.
display_en:
What is the next step?
Try before viewing the explanation.

check.prompt_fil: Ano ang ligtas na sagot sa kaso ni Ampalaya?
check.prompt_en: What is the safe response in the Ampalaya case?

options.fil: Gayahin ang lumang timpla nang walang pagsusuri.
options.en: Copy an old recipe without assessment.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Maaaring maantala o mapalitan ang kinakailangang pangangalaga. 2: Kumpirmahin ang identity, sintomas at saklaw bago magpayo. 3: Hindi kapalit ng kasalukuyang clinical guidance ang lumang timpla.
check.feedback_en: 1: Necessary care may be displaced or delayed. 2: Confirm identity, symptoms and scope before advice. 3: An old recipe does not replace current clinical guidance.

narration_fil: Balikan ang kuwento. Piliin ang angkop na susunod na hakbang.
narration_en: Return to the story. Choose an appropriate next step.

narration_fil: Sa Lunes, ihambing ang dalawang card na may pangalang Ampalaya. Markahan ang botanical name, dahon, nakalistang gamit at referral. Ipasuri ang card sa supervisor.
narration_en: On Monday, compare two cards labelled Ampalaya. Mark the botanical name, leaves, listed use and referral. Review the card with a supervisor.
